description_en: Dhana Bāhāḥ is a branch of Oku Bāhāḥ (LAL2260). It is located in Jyāthā Ṭola to the south of Nau Bāhāḥ (LAL2380) and can be accessed via two small alleys. One of these leads off from the alleyway at the south-west corner of Iche Bāhāḥ (LAL2370) whilst the other is connected to the alley heading east from Jyathā Tol to Prayag Pokhari. The Bāhāḥ consists of a small courtyard with a main sanctum building at its center. Aśikharakūṭa caitya(180cm high), adharmadhātu maṇḍala(55cm high) and a bell can be found in front of the sanctum building, i.e. to its west. The courtyard is surrounded by tall buildings on all sides.Bāhāḥs such as this are commonly home to agod-house (dyaḥchẽ),however this structure is lacking here. Instead, the courtyard contains a single-storey structure that faces west and has a carved door on its principal façade. The door is crowned by a carvedtoraṇa,which in turn is supported by carved pillars. This building has timber posts at each of its corners and has been built usingdāciapā. The concrete pitched roof appears to be a new addition to the structure and is topped with a stonestūpathat acts as a finial.One can circumambulate the temple by following a narrow path. In 2001, Aṣṭarāja Śākya donated funds to replace the old tiled roof with a RCC slab. This is now also topped with acaityathat serves as a finial. Entering the sanctum, one passes beneath a woodentoraṇawith Akṣobhya at its center. Inside the sanctum, one can also find a stone image of Akṣobhya. Two small niches flank the entrance door. A copper image of a four-handed dancing Gaṇeśa has been placed inside the northern niche, whilst the southern niche is furnished with an image of Mahākāla holding akartṛand akapālapātra.Dhanajyoti Śākya was a citizen of Jyāthā and a gold jeweler. He established this Bāhāḥ in 1845 (NS 965) after having consecrated acaitya. Later, in 1936, Vratarāja Śākya built a temple and enshrined Akṣobhya in the sanctum. These events are referred to in two inscriptions dated NS 965 and NS 1056. They are attached to the northern and southern walls of the temple respectively.
description_ne: यो बाहा: ओकुबाहा: सँगै रहेको ज्याथा टोलमा पर्दछ । ज्याथा टोलबाट दक्षिणतिरको गल्लीभित्र छिर्दा बाटोको पूर्वतिर यो बाहा: पर्दछ । यो रुद्रवर्ण महाविहार, ओकुबाहा:को शाखा विहार हो । अन्य बाहा:मा जस्तो यहाँ द्य:छेँ बनाइएको छैन, सानो मन्दिर मात्र रहेको छ । पश्चिमाभिमुख यो मन्दिर एक तल्ला मात्र छ । चारैतिर प्रदक्षिणा गर्न मिल्ने गरी स्वतन्त्र रूपले बनाइएको यस मन्दिरको छाना सिमेन्टले ढलान गरिएको छ । पहिले यहाँ झिंगटीकै छाना राखिएको थियो, तर छाना बिग्रेपछि विसं २०५८ (सन् २००१) तिर अष्टराज शाक्यले ढलान गराएका थिए । छानामा चैत्यलाई गजूरको रूपमा राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकामाथि अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध अंकित काष्ठ तोरण राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र ढुंगाको अक्षोभ्य बुद्धको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । ढोकाको उत्तरमा रहेको खोपामा तामाबाट निर्मित चार हात भएका नाचिरहेको गणेशको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । ढोकाको दक्षिणमा रहेको खोपामा कर्तृ र कपालपात्र धारण गरेका महाकालको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । मन्दिरको उत्तपट्टिको भित्तमा नेसं ९६५ र दक्षिणपट्टिको भित्तामा नेसं १०५६ को शिलापत्र टाँसिएको छ । बाहा: प्राङ्गणमा शिखरकूट चैत्य, धर्मधातु मण्डल र घण्टा स्थापना गरिएको छ ।नेसं ९६५ मा ज्याथाकै धनज्योति शाक्यले एउटा चैत्य बनाई यो विहार स्थापना गरेका थिए । धनज्योति शाक्य सुन कालिगढ थिए । पछि नेसं १०५६ मा ज्योतिष, रत्न-परीक्षा लगायत विविध शिल्पका ज्ञाता व्रतराज शाक्यले मन्दिर बनाएर अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध स्थापना गरेका थिए ।

historical_events.event_name: Dhana Bāhāḥ, construction of the Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala
historical_events.event_description: Harṣajyoti and Śrīramāyā constructed this Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala.

historical_events.event_name: Dhana Bāhāḥ, consecration of the Śikharakūṭa Caitya
historical_events.event_description: Dhanajyoti Śākyavaṃśa constructed this Śikharakūṭa Caitya.
Pañcajoti, his wife Ghanalakṣmī, and their son Candramāna donated funds for a new bell stand.

historical_events.event_name: Dhana Bāhāḥ, construction of the main shrine
historical_events.event_description: Vratarāja Śākya and his family members (Indramāyā, Vyatimāyā, Cinimāyā, Viṣṇu Kumāri and Harṣa Kumāri) constructed a small shrine for the Akṣobhya Buddha

historical_events.event_name: Stone inscription of NS 1059 on the Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala
